A matrix-factorization model learns from MovieLens user ratings, predicts ratings for unseen movies, and recommends the highest-scored titles.

The model trains locally in your browser. No account or backend is used.

ABOUT THIS PROJECT

Movie discovery,
made explainable.

A student project with a locally trained rating-prediction model and a transparent MovieLens data pipeline.

Project Title
Movie Recommendation System Using Machine Learning
Project Type
Full-stack academic project
Programme
AI for Youth Program
Semester
3rd Semester
Technologies
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, Flask, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn
Dataset
MovieLens Latest Small — movies, ratings, and tags from GroupLens.
Machine Learning Method
Collaborative filtering with user/movie latent factors trained by stochastic gradient descent on real MovieLens ratings.
Evaluation
Random held-out ratings, with RMSE and MAE reported by the trained model.
Extra Discovery
Content-based TF-IDF similarity remains available as a separate feature; it is not the rating-prediction model.
ⓘ The model trains on anonymized dataset ratings in this browser. MovieLens user IDs are anonymous demo profiles, not accounts; watchlists stay in this browser.
CCineMatch

Movie metadata and ratings: MovieLens Latest Small, GroupLens Research.

Educational project · No account required
